text:
Aids to Navigation - Kingston to Cornwall - Brockville
Privately maintained orange and white mooring buoy with flashing amber light and radar reflector marking the shipwreck "Muscallonge" placed for the navigational season.
    Aids: 
                Muskallonge mooring buoy MUSK
                                                    Cancels NW-C-3472-25
